name: PRWW1-beast-table-not-chooseTable
old: export const beastTable = (pose) => chooseTable({ transformed: true, riding: !!pose?.rd, stopped: !peerMoving(pose), sheathed: !pose?.wd });   // A beast on the wall walks no stride
new: export const beastTable = (pose) => (pose?.mv ? 'MoveLycan' : 'IdleLycan');   // A beast on the wall walks no stride

name: PRWW1-claw-off-the-lycan-tick
old: while (r.claw && r.claw.t >= LYCAN_TICK) { r.claw.t -= LYCAN_TICK; r.claw.i++; if (r.claw.i >= frameCount(CLAW_TABLE)) r.claw = null; }
new: while (r.claw && r.claw.t >= LYCAN_TICK * 2) { r.claw.t -= LYCAN_TICK * 2; r.claw.i++; if (r.claw.i >= frameCount(CLAW_TABLE)) r.claw = null; }

name: PRWW1-run-clock-unchanged
old: else if (n > 1) { r.clock += Math.max(0, dt); const ft = frameTime(riding) * (beast && !riding ? speedMod({ running: pose.mv === 2 && peerMoving(pose) }) : 1); while (r.clock >= ft) { r.clock -= ft; r.frame = (r.frame + 1) % n; } }

name: PRWW1-mounted-beast-on-the-foot-clock
old: else if (n > 1) { r.clock += Math.max(0, dt); const ft = frameTime(riding) * (beast && !riding ? speedMod({ running: pose.mv === 2 && peerMoving(pose) }) : 1); while (r.clock >= ft) { r.clock -= ft; r.frame = (r.frame + 1) % n; } }
